B1.selection: every out/s3/runs/blind-*.json (not .attempt.json) whose freeze.freeze_hash is freeze 1's, the puzzle record excluded

definitions.evaluation: each design contributes once, from its permutation p1; the per-kind counts are checked identical across all K = 5 permutations of every record (all: True)
definitions.pooling: MICRO over items: raw counts summed over the designs of the set, the rate taken once (docs/S3.md 5.1). Macro recall = unweighted mean of per-design recall over designs with a register of the kind.
definitions.recall: registers of the kind credited / registers of the kind (score.py Truth.denominators, strict items: a synchronizer register in a declared chain unit is credited through the unit)
definitions.precision: structures of the kind that are found (matched an item accepting the kind) / structures of the kind (docs/S3.md: the two rates have different denominators)
definitions.verified: the same, over harness-VERIFIED structures only (score.py classes.verified)
definitions.false_positive_structures: structures of the kind - structures matched (found)
definitions.bootstrap: design-level cluster bootstrap: resample designs with replacement, recompute the pooled ratio sum(numerator)/sum(registers); 10000 resamples; a FRESH numpy.random.default_rng(20260923) for every interval; index matrices drawn with rng.integers(0, n_designs, size=(10000, n_designs)); for a two-set statistic the B1 matrix is drawn first, then the R matrix, from the same generator, and the R - B1 difference and the stratified pooled ratio are computed from those same resamples; the pooled sensitivity resamples the 20 designs (B1 then R, in run order) as one set; percentile interval numpy.percentile(stat, [2.5, 97.5]) (numpy's default linear method); a resample with no register of the kind is dropped and counted. Designs are indexed in run order within each set.
definitions.fisher: two-sided Fisher exact test on [[R hits, R misses], [B1 hits, B1 misses]]; p = sum of table probabilities <= the observed one (relative tolerance 1e-7); exact integer arithmetic
definitions.clopper_pearson: exact binomial 95% interval by bisection on the binomial tails
definitions.tiers:
docs/S3.md section 4, exactly as freeze 1's analysis computed it (out/s3/blind/analysis/
audit_labels.py reg_weakness + build_labels.py tier): over the register's truth bits that carry a
netlist flop, a bit whose z3 mapping proof is not 'proven' or whose random-simulation check is not
'match' (an absent field counts as not proven / not matching) makes the register Tier A
('A_contradicted'); otherwise a bit with no netlist flop makes it Tier B ('B_narrowed'); otherwise
'C_clean'. Sub-tier (write_labels.py's A1/A2): A1 when at least one mapped bit is not 'match' in
simulation, else A2 (z3 not proven while simulation agreed).

PRIMARY -- counter harness-VERIFIED found recall over registers (strict); design-level cluster bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20260923), percentile 95%.
  R  (replication, 10 designs):  19/49 = 0.3878  bootstrap 95% [0.2245, 0.6286]
  B1 (freeze 1, 10 designs):    23/59 = 0.3898  bootstrap 95% [0.2162, 0.6458]
  R - B1:  -0.0021  bootstrap 95% [-0.3121, 0.2853] (each set resampled independently)
  Pooled B1+R (20 designs): 42/108 = 0.3889  bootstrap 95% [0.2617, 0.5517] (resampled within each set); sensitivity, 20 designs as one set: [0.2583, 0.5534]
  Independence-assuming comparison (the first report's): Fisher exact two-sided p (R vs B1) = 1.0000; Clopper-Pearson 95%: R [0.2520, 0.5376], B1 [0.2655, 0.5256], pooled [0.2966, 0.4875]
  VERDICT (plan's words): consistent with freeze 1

_meta.aggregation: one item per structure-kind truth register, except a synchronizer register of a declared chain unit, which is counted through its unit, plus one item per declared structure-kind unit; found = matched a harness-verified structure of an accepted kind at IoU > 0.5; exact = equal flop sets and verified; both libraries pooled (a design contributes twice). This is review[2]'s own aggregation, and the one every published holdout figure has used.
caveats: The corpus is SYNTHETIC and was written by the same project as the recognizer; several of its classes (cohort 2) were added because the generalisation regression set showed them missing (changes.jsonl C23, C31). It is the best out-of-sample estimate that survives this round, not an independent one.

The generalisation regression sets (out/s3/review_generalisation, review_generalisation2) are NO LONGER held out: counter.py, lfsr.py, shift.py, controls.py and verify.py all consulted them (changes.jsonl C25).

TEMPO is the development design: every TEMPO figure is in-sample. Four recognizer fixes were traced from TEMPO misses by truth name (changes.jsonl C27-C30), and PC03, PC06, PC07, PC09, C01-C06, C10 and C21(d) were selected on TEMPO.
These rates come from ONE seeded corpus evaluation; they carry no confidence interval.

THE false_positive_structures COLUMN OVERSTATES; found / exact and their denominators do NOT. out/s3/review_generalisation2/evaluate.py's outcomes() builds its item list from truth registers whose kind is in STRUCTURE_KINDS, so a 'flag' register's alt_kinds are never consulted. Under the truth's TOGGLE_RULE a 1-bit toggle is kind 'flag' with alt_kinds ['counter'] -- the truth EXPLICITLY ACCEPTS a counter over it -- yet such a prediction matches no item there and is scored a false positive. Counted on the evaluation this document was derived from, as false-positive structures of width 1 lying entirely in one truth register of kind 'flag': holdout 2 of 6, train 10 of 16. The overstatement is in the CONSERVATIVE direction. tools/s3/score.py -- the scorer every published table comes from -- does not make this error: score.Truth builds accepts from alt_kinds for EVERY truth register, a flag included. The scoring rule is left as it is on purpose: changing it would move a published out-of-sample number without a lead decision (changes.jsonl T04, T14).
